description: Focused tasks to close the remaining security findings in Gestao Facil.

tasks.description: Upgrade to a compatible current Spring Boot 4.x and Spring Framework 7.x release.
tasks.reason: The current Spring MVC dependency is affected by CVE-2026-47884 and CVE-2026-47890, with no patched Spring 6.2 artifact identified in the existing security review.
tasks.requirements: Keep Java 25. Select available compatible patched Spring Boot 4.x and Spring Framework 7.x artifacts that remove CVE-2026-47884 and CVE-2026-47890. Resolve SpringDoc and any other compatibility issues; do not retain known CVEs to avoid the major upgrade. Verify Maven tests and build, and run Trivy if available. Preserve existing user changes.

tasks.description: Move browser authentication to secure server-managed JWT cookies with CSRF protection.
tasks.reason: Bearer JWTs in localStorage are exposed to browser-side script access, and cookie-based authentication requires deliberate CSRF protection.
tasks.requirements: Replace browser localStorage bearer JWT authentication with server-set HttpOnly JWT cookies; make Secure configurable for local development and production and select an appropriate SameSite policy. Protect state-changing requests against CSRF and expose safe CSRF-token acquisition for Axios. Enable credentialed CORS only for explicit trusted origins. Update login, first-user setup auto-login, logout, protected-route behavior, session detection, tests, and docs. Preserve server-side token revocation. Never log credentials, tokens, cookies, or CSRF tokens, and do not persist bearer tokens in browser storage. Add or adjust auth-flow, cookie/session, and CSRF tests as feasible.

tasks.description: Replace per-process authentication limits with shared Redis-backed limits.
tasks.reason: In-memory, per-instance rate limits do not aggregate authentication attempts across application replicas.
tasks.requirements: Implement atomic/shared Redis-backed authentication rate limits. Wire required configuration into development and production Docker Compose, environment examples, and production documentation. Ensure Redis unavailability results in explicit startup failure or documented fail-closed behavior, with no silent in-memory fallback. Do not trust spoofable forwarded-IP headers unless a trusted-proxy policy is explicitly enforced. Add or adjust tests for shared limits, Redis-unavailable behavior, and relevant authentication flows as feasible.

tasks.description: Verify the completed security changes and update the security report and user documentation.
tasks.reason: The existing security review identifies three residual findings and must report verified outcomes and remaining risk accurately.
tasks.requirements: Run targeted tests for the changed authentication, CSRF, cookie/session, and rate-limit behavior, followed by the relevant full tests and Maven build. Run Trivy if available. Update SECURITY_REVIEW.md with accurate final outcomes, actual test and scan evidence, and residual risks; update production documentation and README link if appropriate. Document any unavailable scan, failed setup, or other concrete environment blocker; do not claim unobserved results. Preserve existing user changes. Stop once targeted/full relevant tests and available scans have run or a concrete environment blocker is documented. Do not create a Git repository or commit.
